Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Farming
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: Machines that work your fields: mark a growing zone as a paddock, and tractors plough, cultivate and sow it, and a combine harvester cuts it, row by row, by themselves.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.otherMods: With The Dead Man's Switch - Legion, its Agricultural Frame drops hay only for crops that leave straw (a setting in Options > Mod settings > D'thorga Farming).

li.label: Easier
li.description: Colonists may sow and harvest a new paddock by hand too, and a machine's driver never fails a harvest.

li.label: Standard
li.description: A new paddock is for machines only, and a machine's driver can fail a harvest as a colonist by hand can.

li.label: Harsher
li.description: As Standard, and colonists sowing by hand take seed from a stockpile, as machines do.
